title: For Lee Jun-hyuk, the real jackpot is finding purpose in his work
caption:
Why would someone win the lottery and stay at their cubicle? In Seoul, an after-tax payout of 1.3 billion won is not enough to retire on, but the psychological motive to keep clocking in runs much deeper.
